iterations.summary: Implemented the box_prior_v1 K=10 workflow scaffold and launched the scratch Infinigen training job on the A800 host.
completed: Added K=10 launcher/evaluator/auto-review workflow for the box_prior_v1 campaign.
Prepared the combined Infinigen box dataset with TuckEnd included and encoded the shape codebook.
Validated true fine-tune initialization from the PartNet 5455.pt checkpoint after ignoring p_pe for the K=10 adaptation.
Started the background infinigen_k10 scratch training job through the manifest-driven loop.

bugs_fixed.bug: Fine-tune initialization failed for K=10 because the checkpoint positional embedding shape still assumed K=8.
bugs_fixed.root_cause: network_dict.denoiser.p_pe depends on max_K and cannot be loaded verbatim from the K=8 checkpoint.
bugs_fixed.fix: Added p_pe to logging.ignore_loading_key in the K=10 fine-tune config so the pretrained backbone still loads cleanly.

bugs_fixed.bug: Launcher metadata vanished after training started, making the loop think experiment status was missing.
bugs_fixed.root_cause: PhysNAP recreates log/<exp> at startup and deleted run_meta.json/resolved_config.yaml written there ahead of launch.
bugs_fixed.fix: Moved authoritative run metadata and resolved configs into campaign runtime sidecars and added lock-based status recovery.

lessons: For box-domain K upgrades, checkpoint loading should explicitly ignore K-shaped tensors instead of pretending the run is a true full-parameter resume.
Experiment status for long PhysNAP jobs must live outside the training log directory because the framework mutates that directory during startup.
architecture_changes: Introduced a manifest-driven box_prior_v1 campaign with persistent state, summary, review, and next-action files.
Split experiment runtime bookkeeping into campaign sidecars instead of relying on PhysNAP log directories.
Standardized the training/evaluation entrypoints around explicit K=10 box-domain experiment modes.
next: Wait for infinigen_k10 to produce stable checkpoints, then launch finetune_k10 through the same queue.
Run the unified evaluator to generate box-domain and PartNet sanity comparison reports.
Commit the workflow/code changes once the active training job is safely running and the campaign state is consistent.

iterations.summary: Reconciled the completed K=10 scratch run, launched the true fine-tune run, and enabled run-to-completion polling for the box_prior_v1 campaign.
completed: Verified the K=10 scratch training reached a full-duration 2400_latest.pt checkpoint and promoted it to completed.
Launched the true finetune_k10 run from the PartNet 5455.pt baseline checkpoint with exit-code sidecar tracking.
Added a campaign dashboard and run-to-completion polling so the loop can continue through evaluation without manual retriggering.

bugs_fixed.bug: The first scratch run finished under the legacy launcher path and was left in a conservative stopped state.
bugs_fixed.root_cause: That run predated exit-code sidecars, so completion had to be inferred from checkpoints and log evidence.
bugs_fixed.fix: Added checkpoint/log-based completion reconciliation and promoted the scratch run to completed when it matched the expected full-duration trace.

bugs_fixed.bug: The loop still required manual retriggering after each long training stage.
bugs_fixed.root_cause: The original run-until-blocked mode exited as soon as a background job started.
bugs_fixed.fix: Added run-to-completion polling and launched it as a background watcher for the active campaign.

lessons: For unattended research loops, training orchestration needs both per-job exit tracking and a higher-level poller that advances the queue when GPUs go idle.
A reviewable campaign dashboard is essential; otherwise the queue can be technically correct but still opaque to the human researcher.
architecture_changes: Added a dashboard writer to the auto-review loop for persistent experiment-stage visibility.
Added run-to-completion polling to the auto-review loop so a single launched process can drive training through evaluation.
Added checkpoint/log-based completion reconciliation for legacy stopped jobs.
next: Let finetune_k10 reach its terminal checkpoint and confirm the exit code sidecar marks it completed.

iterations.summary: Cleared the Infinigen->PhysNAP representation-fidelity blocker, regenerated repaired box data, and launched repaired scratch retraining.
completed: Regenerated all four box graph datasets with visual-origin-aware conversion.
Rebuilt combined_k10 and regenerated the Infinigen box codebook.
Re-ran conversion audit and established a healthy box GT self-eval gate.
Launched infinigen_k10_fixed on the repaired dataset.

bugs_fixed.bug: Per-box and combined K=10 datasets were still derived from the pre-fix converter that ignored URDF visual origins.
bugs_fixed.root_cause: prepare_k10 only merged existing .npz files and never re-converted raw Phase-1 data after the converter changed.
bugs_fixed.fix: prepare_k10 now rebuilds per-box datasets from raw exports and invalidates stale box reference caches when forced.

bugs_fixed.bug: Conversion audit treated visual-origin sensitivity itself as a blocker instead of checking whether the saved dataset matched the fixed converter.
bugs_fixed.root_cause: The audit compared fixed vs buggy conversion variants but did not measure saved-vs-fixed fidelity.
bugs_fixed.fix: Audit now reports saved-vs-fixed errors, saved alignment, and PartNet GT control metrics.

bugs_fixed.bug: PhysNAP audit scripts could crash on libstdc++/PIL binary mismatch before GT evaluation started.
bugs_fixed.root_cause: The physnap environment sometimes loaded the system libstdc++ instead of the conda copy required by Pillow/libLerc.
bugs_fixed.fix: Added an auto re-exec preload guard so audit/evaluator processes start with the conda libstdc++.so.6 preloaded.

lessons: A converter bug that changes local frames invalidates all downstream training and evaluation artifacts; those artifacts must be treated as archival after regeneration.
Box GT physics can be healthy even when PartNet GT exceeds an absolute E_pen/E_mob threshold, so those thresholds are not domain-universal.
architecture_changes: prepare_k10 now has a raw-data reconversion stage before merge/codebook generation.
Added repaired training branch configs and launcher modes: infinigen_k10_fixed / finetune_k10_fixed.
Audit and evaluator now surface saved-dataset fidelity and PartNet GT self-eval controls.
next: Let infinigen_k10_fixed finish and then launch finetune_k10_fixed.
Re-run evaluation on baseline / infinigen_k10_fixed / finetune_k10_fixed.
Decide whether the repaired branch supports the prior claim or only a weaker representation/benchmark result.
